options.torched.throw_on_use.tooltip: Right-clicking with nothing in range throws the torch you are holding. Turn this off to throw only with the throw key.
options.torched.throw_vanilla_torches.to: Whether ordinary torches can be thrown, or only sticky ones. Servers enforce their own setting, so turning this on cannot override a server that has it off.
